verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Navan card transactions exist and that the MCP server can report card status ('see which cards are active or inactive, how many cards a user has'), but nothing documents issuing physical or virtual cards, how fast issuance is, or setting a spend limit per card. Read-only card visibility, transaction retrieval and connecting existing third-party cards are adjacent features, not the issuance-with-limits capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit
